, in Manipur, the injecting drug user population is highly mobile and the personal network of new injecting drug users is mixed in terms of injecting practice, age, and marital status.

, in Manipur, the network of older injecting drug users is a potential source of HIV exposure among younger injecting drug users, who are more likely to be recruited into the network of older drug users.
